rows.name: Connecticut State Marshal Commission
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut state marshals & recipients of legal service
rows.criticalNote: 1 of 8 seats is governor-appointed (1 judge by the Chief Justice, 6 by legislative leaders)
rows.mandate: Oversees and appoints Connecticut state marshals. Eight-member commission; the Governor appoints one member as chairperson, the Chief Justice one Superior Court judge, and legislative leaders the remaining six (CGS § 6-38b).

rows.name: Developmental Disabilities, Connecticut Council of
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut residents with developmental disabilities
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)
rows.mandate: Federally mandated DD Council advocating for Connecticut residents with developmental disabilities. Twenty-four governor-appointed members.

rows.name: Educational Technology, Commission for
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut students, libraries & educational-technology users
rows.criticalNote: 2 governor-appointed members; remainder ex-officio officials and association representatives
rows.mandate: Coordinates Connecticut's educational-technology strategy across schools, libraries and higher education. Two business/IT-expert members appointed by the Governor, alongside ex-officio state officials and named association representatives (CGS § 4d-80).

rows.name: Elections Enforcement Commission, State
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut voters & the integrity of state elections
rows.criticalNote: 1 of 5 seats is governor-appointed (4 appointed by legislative leaders)
rows.mandate: Enforces Connecticut's election and campaign-finance laws. Five-member commission; one member appointed by the Governor and one each by the four legislative leaders, all with General Assembly consent (CGS § 9-7a).

rows.name: Employees' Review Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut non-union state employees with grievances
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)
rows.mandate: Hears and decides grievances of non-union Connecticut state employees. Seven members appointed by the Governor, at least one an attorney experienced in administrative or labor law (CGS § 5-201).

rows.name: Environmental Quality, Council on
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut's environment & the public's right to monitor it
rows.criticalNote: 5 of 9 seats are governor-appointed (4 appointed by legislative leaders)
rows.mandate: Independent monitor of Connecticut's environmental quality and compliance. Nine-member council; five members appointed by the Governor (including the chair), two by the Speaker of the House, two by the Senate President Pro Tempore (CGS § 22a-11).

rows.name: Examining Board for Crane Operators
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut crane operators, owners & worksite public safety
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)
rows.mandate: Licenses crane operators and sets crane-safety standards in Connecticut. Five members appointed by the Governor — a department employee, an experienced crane operator, a crane-owner representative, and two public members (CGS § 29-221).

rows.name: Fire Marshal Training Council
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Fire Prevention and Control, Commission on
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut firefighters & the public they protect
rows.criticalNote: 12 governor-appointed members plus 2 ex-officio voting members
rows.mandate: Sets Connecticut's firefighter training and certification standards. Twelve members appointed by the Governor representing named fire-service organizations, plus the State Fire Marshal and community-college chancellor ex officio (CGS § 7-323k).

rows.name: Fire Prevention Code Advisory Committee
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Firearms Permit Examiners, Board of
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut pistol-permit applicants & the public
rows.criticalNote: 8 of 9 seats are governor-appointed (1 retired judge named by the Chief Court Administrator)
rows.mandate: Hears appeals from denials and revocations of firearm permits and certificates. Nine-member board; eight members appointed by the Governor from named organizations' nominees (at least one a licensed attorney), plus one retired Superior Court judge named by the Chief Court Administrator (CGS § 29-32b).

rows.name: Freedom of Information Commission
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut residents seeking access to public records & meetings
rows.criticalNote: 5 of 9 seats are governor-appointed (4 appointed by legislative leaders)
rows.mandate: Enforces Connecticut's Freedom of Information Act and adjudicates access complaints. Nine-member commission; five members appointed by the Governor, four by legislative leaders, all with General Assembly consent (CGS § 1-205).

rows.name: Health Equity, Commission on
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Human Rights and Opportunities, Commission on
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut residents protected under state anti-discrimination law
rows.criticalNote: 5 of 9 seats are governor-appointed (4 appointed by legislative leaders)
rows.mandate: Enforces Connecticut's anti-discrimination laws and adjudicates civil-rights complaints. Nine-member commission; five members appointed by the Governor, four by legislative leaders, all with General Assembly consent (CGS § 46a-52).

rows.name: Intergovernmental Relations, Advisory Commission on
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Judicial Review Council
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut residents & accountability of the state judiciary
rows.criticalNote: 12 governor-appointed members (with General Assembly approval); 13 alternate members excluded
rows.mandate: Investigates complaints of judicial misconduct or disability in Connecticut. Twelve members — three Superior Court judges, three attorneys, and six public members — all appointed by the Governor with the approval of the General Assembly (CGS § 51-51k).

rows.name: Judicial Selection Commission
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut residents & the integrity of the state judiciary
rows.criticalNote: 6 of 12 seats are governor-appointed (6 appointed by legislative leaders)
rows.mandate: Vets and recommends candidates for Connecticut judgeships. Twelve-member commission; six members appointed by the Governor (all attorneys, one from each congressional district), six by legislative leaders (CGS § 51-44a).

rows.name: Management Advisory Council
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Pardons and Paroles, Board of
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut's incarcerated people, parolees & pardon applicants
rows.criticalNote: Ten full-time governor-appointed members; the Governor may also appoint up to five part-time members
rows.mandate: Grants paroles and pardons and sets release policy in Connecticut. Ten full-time members appointed by the Governor with the consent of the General Assembly (CGS § 54-124a).

rows.name: Psychiatric Security Review Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut insanity acquittees, victims & the public
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)
rows.mandate: Supervises persons acquitted by reason of mental disease and committed to its jurisdiction. Six governor-appointed members — a psychiatrist, a psychologist, a probation expert, an attorney, and two public members (CGS § 17a-581).

rows.name: Racial and Ethnic Disparity Commission in the Criminal Justice System
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: School Building Projects Advisory Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Sentencing Commission
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut's criminal-justice system & the public
rows.criticalNote: 1 of 23 voting members is governor-appointed (remainder ex-officio and legislative)
rows.mandate: Reviews Connecticut's criminal sentencing policies and recommends reforms. Twenty-three-member commission; one public member appointed by the Governor, the remainder ex-officio justice officials and legislative appointees (CGS § 54-300).

rows.name: Siting Council
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut communities affected by energy & telecom facilities
rows.criticalNote: 5 of 9 seats are governor-appointed (2 legislative, 2 ex officio)
rows.mandate: Decides the siting of power plants, transmission lines and telecommunication towers. Nine-member council; five members appointed by the Governor (including the chair), two by legislative leaders, plus the DEEP Commissioner and PURA chair ex officio (CGS § 16-50j).

rows.name: State Contracting Standards Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut taxpayers & the integrity of state procurement
rows.criticalNote: 8 of 14 seats are governor-appointed (6 appointed by legislative leaders)
rows.mandate: Oversees and reforms Connecticut's state contracting and procurement. Fourteen-member board; eight members appointed by the Governor (including the chair), six by legislative leaders (CGS § 4e-2).

rows.name: State Emergency Response Commission
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut communities exposed to hazardous-materials risk
rows.criticalNote: 9 of 18 seats are governor-appointed
rows.mandate: Coordinates Connecticut's hazardous-materials emergency planning and right-to-know program. Eighteen-member commission; nine members appointed by the Governor (four public, three facility operators, one municipal fire chief, plus the chair) (CGS § 22a-601).

rows.name: State Insurance and Risk Management Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut taxpayers & the state's insured assets
rows.criticalNote: 9 governor-appointed members plus the Comptroller ex officio
rows.mandate: Directs Connecticut's state insurance and risk-management program. Nine members appointed by the Governor (three public members, six qualified by training/experience), plus the Comptroller ex officio (CGS § 4a-19).

rows.name: State Properties Review Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Teachers' Retirement Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut public-school teachers & retirees
rows.criticalNote: 5 governor-appointed public members; the remaining seats are elected teacher/retiree members and ex-officio officials
rows.mandate: Administers the Connecticut Teachers' Retirement System. Board includes five public members appointed by the Governor, alongside elected teacher/retiree members and ex-officio state officials (CGS ch. 167a).

rows.name: Workers' Compensation Commission
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Connecticut Medical Examining Board
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut patients & licensed physicians
rows.criticalNote: Listed in CT's official Boards, Councils & Commissions directory; CT publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Connecticut physicians. Twenty-one governor-appointed members — thirteen physicians, one physician assistant, seven public members (CGS § 20-8a).

rows.name: Connecticut State Board of Education
rows.authority: Governor's Office via DAS Statewide HR
rows.constituent: Connecticut K-12 students & families
rows.criticalNote: 9 governor-appointed voting members; board also seats 3 ex-officio and 2 nonvoting student members
rows.mandate: Oversees Connecticut's public elementary and secondary education. Nine governor-appointed voting members, alongside three ex-officio members and two (nonvoting) student members (CGS § 10-1).
